answer: The spiral cap is policed at intake and fable makes public the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a lagoon tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 25 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
